notes.title: A new version of Tiny Tied Demo is out!
notes.notes:
Hey, remember Mi?

I know it’s been a long time since the last update. As a solodev it takes time until I can enrich you with more content. So I can only apologize for the long wait for the next updates. But you should know that I am continuously working on the game!

Anyway, finally there is more content with the new [b]demo update v0.3.0[/b]! This includes bug fixes, optimizations, and of course more content about the story and game mechanics!


[h1]YOU CAN NOW SAVE AND LOAD THE GAME[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43763967/c9a9540dfb30408889ec82def1d089eca6bc4c8d.png[/img]

Just speak to this person to save. It’s very simple. 

Just a little tip: some actions can’t be undone (and of course have consequences), so be sure to check before you save.


[h1]YOU CAN NOW HAVE ALLIES[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43763967/84178f6de4f10d6f8e4114074cfc7ee1f57e027d.png[/img]

If you befriend Gustavo in battle, he will join you as an ally! There are other ways for him to join you, but he would be very grateful for the friendly way. Allies will accompany you in the overworld and (usually) give you useful information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43763967/dc313b16d77362e810a6f28ba1e181ecae12961b.png[/img]

And of course they will also support you in battle!


[h1]A NEW OPPONENT - ALLYZABETH[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43763967/18c334b4a440b4056ccf544d8699e0cb4816dc1b.png[/img]

As you continue your journey, you will be given the opportunity to fight Allyzabeth. She will teach you further mechanics during a fight as part of a tutorial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43763967/7746ade977f844c6edb5fb1c657b465d96a18b06.png[/img]

She has a short fuse, so be careful not to provoke her too much. Or at all.


[h1]GENERALLY MORE CONTENT[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43763967/8c553eeb24584898edf8bcd0e97962db90214f21.png[/img]

Just a little info that more and more characters will be coming into the game to fill the world with life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43763967/870935085e3517b42942922e2bcc8794e70c8776.png[/img]

Well… more or less.


That’s all the major updates so far. I hope it will go faster until the next big update. We’ll see…

[b]Until then, have fun with the new version![/b]

notes.title: Tiny update v 0.2.1
notes.notes:
The window should now be resizable, so you can adapt the window size at will.
This should solve the problem of the game window size being tiny (heh) on big screens.

notes.title: Version 0.2.0 is already out!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] fixed some typos
[*] static obstacles and targets in combat won’t trigger the graze effect anymore (yeah the little sparkles are grazes which increases your mana I just haven’t explained it yet lol)
[*] made Mi’s running less floaty
[*] added transparency to forest trees
[*] Reworked overworld music
[*] mapped WASD to movement controls
[*] mapped Xbox controller to input
[*] signs who explain the controls now switch their personality to which device you currently use (keyboard or gamepad) before you first interact with them
[/list]
